cohort: 80 newborns with congenital anomalies admitted to a tertiary care hospital in Lahore, Pakistan between January 2012 and December 2012.
finding: Hydrocephaly, Anencephaly, Arcania, ompalocele, spina bifida and Arnolad Chiari were the most common congenital anomalies observed, and young maternal age, cousin marriages, drug intake, previous baby with anomaly, family history of anomalies, and lack of maternal care were identified as major risk factors.
